event: Check target_user tests and ecc test quickly.

I submitted the verdict as verified: I found no test that closes any of the five gaps. The submission was accepted. I only skimmed the target_user test, so the last item (`TARGET_USER_VALID`) is the least certain.

- **DLEN = 0 clears the whole SRAM:** The zeroize tests I checked never write DLEN = 0. None reads back the full SRAM to confirm it is cleared.
- **Clearing flow order:** No test observes the intermediate clearing-start and clearing-end phases.
- **Single-bit ECC error corrected:** `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_ecc.c` checks only the interrupt and status bits. It never compares the data read back with the data written.
- **Double-bit ECC error returns invalid data:** The same test checks only status and interrupt. It does not check the data returned on the read that hits the error.
- **`TARGET_USER_VALID` writable only while 0:** The one write attempt I found comes from the Caliptra target agent in `cptra_smoke_test_mcu_mbox_target_user.c`. It is not an MCU write while `TARGET_USER_VALID` is 1, so it doesn't close the gap.
